concept.title: People needing food or general support
concept.shortdesc: People in need, mainly those referred to or using a food bank or needing emergency food, plus generic wording about people or families in need.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: people referred to the food bank
people in financial hardship or debt: see (money problem rather than food)
people on a low income: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (income level)

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed. The group re-formed in most resamplings of the data (stability 0.66).
Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. Split into people needing food (food bank users, emergency food, meal support) and people or families simply described as 'in need'.

section.p: Identifier in this run: aud-087. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
